reviews.review: last wave of dev hell is making the game interesting

This game seems to have been in development hell for the past few years and playing it felt worse every time. However it seem that the devs have reworked several key mechanics and the game is actually really fun to play now however the final boss is still hot garbage and the second phase is blatantly unfair 7/10

EDIT:
from the summer update in July to version 1.00
The game has addressed 90% of the issues I had with it. 
There is tons of content, characters are diverse and have deep builds and the weapons are way more interesting. A good amount of progression and things to grind towards but I think you can 100% the game fairly quickly trying (15-20 hours?) 

old review posted below.


Been playing since 0.4 I believe, 
TLDR;
Cons:
-Roguelike elements are there, but do not feel impactful or exciting to acquire.
-Core system feels very under cooked despite (I think) 2 reworks.
-Relatively easy/quick to unlock all of the permanent unlocks in the basecamp.(8 hours I think?)
-Basecamp unlocks aren't exciting and slightly convoluted.
-Rail system is cool but kinda wish it was a bit more present.

Pros: 
+Gunplay and movement feels great
+Tons of guns, most of them are very fun to use. Love the secondary fire addition to a lot of the weapons. Would love if they all had that.
+4 classes to choose from which are all unique(wish there was a class progression system tho. A reason to keep playing them)
+Each level is quite cool and well designed. Love the vibe of most of them. Hoping they add a reason to go to each specific level(Maybe a specific buff attributed to each region that stays with you for the whole run?)

In roguelike games, choices should matter and in Roboquest it feels way too forgiving and easy to switch builds within a moments notice. I dont think that your run should be "ruined" because of one or two choices, but every act you have the opportunity to just try a different build(and it feels encouraged to do so because weapons have a star system aka level, you should be using higher stared weapons). Level up upgrades are pretty close to perfect with this last update, I think that is the most fun part to choose from. Core passive bonus's are very lackluster with the passive bonus's given I also think all passive core bonus's should stack, or they should have random affix's similar to the levelup upgrades. Roboquest as a kind of session based borderlands game is great. As a roguelike FPS it is missing a lot, and feels like it is having an identity crisis.
I like Roboquest quite a bit and Im being overcritical out of love <3
In update 1.0 I might change my review as a few of things mentioned seem to be on the roadmap.
